note: STATE ONLY. Live recommendation, not yet ruled.

items.question: The burst read's MainMissingBars column counts missing candle bars only up to the bar where the outcome walk resolves (TP or SL hit); a gap after an early resolution is not counted. Run 1 STOPs if any population row has MainMissingBars > 0. What should the column count?

options.label: (a)
options.text: accept as built: count missing bars only up to resolution

options.label: (b)
options.text: add a full-window coverage column to the export (changes MediumTierDiagnosisExport.vb output columns)

items.rationale: A bar after resolution cannot change the row's outcome, so counting it would STOP run 1 on gaps that do not matter. Tape completeness over the full window is already measured by the venue check and the history-store comparison. (b) also changes a shared export's columns.
